about: How a run ended, for tools/triage.py and tools/run-report.py. Signatures are tried by priority (lowest first); the first that matches is the verdict, the others are listed too.
Every key in 'match' must hold. 'fallback' (optional) is tried instead when the run's exe was rebuilt since the run, so symbols cannot be checked; a fallback match is marked heuristic.
Locations: 'title+0x...' = the title image (victory-image-<hash>.dll mapped at preferred 0x140000000), 'victory.exe+0x...' = the layer, or any module name; a module without +0x matches any offset.

Conditions: world (true/false), resources_regex (KILLED/CRITICAL lines of logs/resources.log in the run's window), log_regex (+ log_exclude) over the .err log, autopilot_regex, runlog_regex (the launcher's .log), setting (a VICTORY_* switch set), marker_regex ('VIctory: ...' lines), exception ('unhandled' or 'any'), exception_at, exception_module_regex, frames_module_regex, frames_before_layer_regex, symbols_regex (victory.exe frames of the faulting stack through addr2sym), thread + frames_in_order + within_top (a dumped thread's top frames, consecutive), exit_code (list), no_dump (true/false).
Classes: ok, hang, crash, killed, gpu, unknown. A class 'unknown' match prints the symbolized stacks of the faulting thread and title-main.

signatures.name: Killed by the RAM monitor
signatures.advice: Not the build's fault unless its own memory grew: check the RAM section (who held the memory, modified pages, paging) before calling the switch bad. Two in a row stop the queue.

signatures.name: Device removed / TDR
signatures.advice: Read the DRED lines (breadcrumbs, page fault address) in the .err log; VICTORY_D3D12_DRED=light keeps them.

signatures.name: Title GPU watchdog crash (title+0x23cf683, 'GPU Loc Sig')
signatures.advice: The title's own GPU watchdog: a CrossQueueBarrier or fence it waits on was never signalled (VICTORY_FENCE_SWEEP covers the known case).

signatures.name: Profiler crash (the layer's stack walker, crash.rs / stacks.rs)
signatures.advice: Keep VICTORY_PROFILE (and late VICTORY_STACKS) out of measured runs; RtlVirtualUnwind on a suspended thread's stack can fault.

signatures.name: Known load hang (title-main waits at title+0x56a0d < +0x225130)
signatures.advice: The title's frame-tracker lock leak (fixed by VICTORY_TRACKER_UNLOCK, on by default since run 46): seeing it again means the patch did not apply (bytes differ?) or was turned off.

signatures.name: Stuck load, no thread dump (the stuck limit came before VICTORY_STACKS)
signatures.advice: Set VICTORY_STACKS below StuckAfter (run-queue.ps1 does) so the next hang leaves its stacks.

signatures.name: Stuck load, unrecognised wait
signatures.advice: A new hang: compare title-main and the layer's threads in the dump; add its frames as a signature.

signatures.name: Unrecognised crash
signatures.advice: New crash: see the faulting stack; add its location as a signature.

signatures.name: Good: reached the world, ended at the time limit
Good: reached the world, stopped by the autopilot (-StopAfter)
